documents.title: Craighead County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 160 pages. Amounts are the '2026 Budgeted Amount' in the ordinance's Section 5 (pp. 3–7); cross-checked against 'TOTAL DEPARTMENT BUDGET' on each budget page (pp. 19–80) column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.

documents.title: Craighead County 2026 budget (as reported)
documents.note: Figures as reported in local news of the Quorum Court’s 2026 budget adoption. The full ordinance is public record; the artransparency.gov copy blocks automated access, so line-item ingestion awaits a direct pull.
